_note: Independent reference values transcribed from the cited sources, used to check the physics core. Not generated by this code.

hydrogen_vacuum_nm._source: NIST Atomic Spectra Database, H I, vacuum wavelengths (fine-structure averaged); tolerance covers fine structure and Lamb shift

refractive_index._source: Schott N-BK7 data sheet; Malitson 1965 (fused silica); CRC Handbook (diamond, water)

water_absorption_per_cm._source: Segelstein 1981 via OMLC; microwave value consistent with a ~1.7 cm power penetration depth at 2.45 GHz

dna._source: Standard nucleic-acid spectrophotometry: A260 = 1.0 for 50 ug/mL dsDNA in 1 cm; pure DNA A260/A280 ~1.8-2.0, A260/A230 ~2.0-2.4
